entry.title: Water district PFAS compliance: Lunenburg Water District, 2026-10-21
Water district PFAS compliance: Lunenburg Water District, 2026-09-23
entry.summary: Upload the manganese and PFAS data spreadsheet and corresponding charts to the district website, kept current, updated at minimum quarterly — passed

entry.title: Water district PFAS compliance: Lunenburg Water District, 2026-09-08
entry.summary: The board effectively agreed to stop the blending water-quality tests, since the superintendent's conversation with MassDEP established that blending will not be accepted as a long-term compliance method and every individual well must pass PFAS limits on its own.

entry.title: Water district PFAS compliance: Lunenburg Water District, 2026-08-26
entry.summary: Hold off on a formal motion to publish quarterly PFAS/manganese data on the website; first get cost and process details from the vendors Level Up and Pixelated before committing.

entry.title: Water district PFAS compliance: Lunenburg Water District, 2026-08-12
entry.summary: Adopt well-blending as the district's temporary corrective-action response to manganese and PFAS exceedances until DEP specifies a long-term treatment plan.
